**People and roles.** Invite people with a one-time link from the new **Access** page in the sidebar, as an **Admin**, **Operator** or **Viewer**, for one server or all of them, or make your own roles from a list of permissions on the **Roles** tab. People see only the servers and buttons they can use, and changes apply straight away. You become the **Owner** when you update. Click your name at the bottom of the sidebar for **Your account**: your name, light or dark (remembered on every device), passkeys, recovery codes and signing out everywhere else. SSH now has its own section in **System**, and the installer prints a setup link so first-time setup is one click. See [People and roles](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.2.0-beta.2/docs/people.md).

**Public status page.** Each server can have a page anyone can open without signing in, at `/s/<server name>`, showing its icon, MOTD, a description you write, whether it's up, the address to join and who's online (a count, names and heads, or nothing, as you choose). On Fabric it also offers a **modpack** (`.mrpack`) with the server's mods and any client-only extras you add, and a server with its own hostname shows its page at `https://<hostname>`. Turn it on from the server's **Settings**, **Public page**. Existing installs need the installer re-run once, with the same `--domain`, for hostnames to work. See [Public status page](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.2.0-beta.2/docs/status-page.md).

Join and leave notifications are reliable again.

Testing notes are in the "Public status page" and "People and roles" sections of [testing-1.2.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.2.0-beta.2/docs/testing-1.2.0.md).
